Provides data and interactive tools for exploring Australian bushfire
weather risk and climate change findings.

# Package index

## All functions

  : Australian Bushfire Weather Risk Findings
- [`run_app()`](https://etc5523-2026.github.io/etc5523-assignment-4-qyuu0033-design/reference/run_app.md)
  : Run the Australian Bushfire Weather Risk Explorer
- [`summarise_risk()`](https://etc5523-2026.github.io/etc5523-assignment-4-qyuu0033-design/reference/summarise_risk.md)
  : Summarise Australian Bushfire Weather Risk
